message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can’t give you the exact figure for today.  
As a rough guide, the USD/GBP rate has been hovering around **0.78 GBP per 1 USD** in recent weeks. Using that:

\[
20\ \text{USD} \times 0.78\ \frac{\text{GBP}}{\text{USD}} \approx 15.6\ \text{GBP}
\]

So you’d expect about **£15–£16** for $20, give or take a few pence depending on the exact day and the provider’s spread.

For the most accurate conversion, check a trusted financial news site, a bank’s currency converter, or a currency‑exchange app on the day you plan to make the transaction.
